title: Production Candidate Mobile Touchpoint Polish, End-to-End Route Auditing & Final Release Gate Dossier
objective: Perform a comprehensive mobile and desktop usability audit across all V2 learning touchpoints (Zero Japanese -> Hiragana Studio -> Tokyo Journey -> N5 Minna Lessons -> JLPT CBT Simulator -> CV Builder -> Billing), verifying zero mobile layout clipping, responsive touch targets, flawless performance, and compilation of the Master Production Candidate Release Dossier.
in_scope: Audit and optimize mobile touch targets, header spacing, and responsive padding across 360px-390px viewports
Verify seamless mobile navigation across all 15 production routes with zero layout clipping or horizontal overflow
Audit V2 App Lazy Loading and code splitting for lightning-fast sub-second Time-to-Interactive (TTI)
Execute full 9-gate pre-flight verification (Domain Adapters, Orchestrator, Role Security, Knowledge State, Cumulative Lattice, Browser E2E, CV PDF, CBT Exams, Payments)
Capture mobile and desktop browser evidence across the complete learner journey
Compile the Master Production Release Dossier for Founder final sign-off
out_of_scope: Native iOS/Android Swift/Kotlin app store packaging (web mobile PWA only)
acceptance_criteria: Mobile viewports (360px, 390px, 412px) render with zero horizontal scrollbar or clipped headers
All interactive elements (buttons, inputs, tabs) maintain minimum 44px touch targets on touch devices
All 9 pre-flight release gates pass 100% with zero warnings or test failures
Production build output is clean in dist/ with zero TypeScript errors
Master Production Candidate Dossier is documented with full verifiable evidence
risks: Mobile browser viewport differences across iOS Safari and Android Chrome. Mitigation: Test on standardized responsive viewports with CSS safe-area-inset.
